Hey everyone!

Brandon here, founder of DailyHelm.  
  
What is DailyHelm

DailyHelm is an agentic AI business reviewer for online businesses. It turns scattered analytics, ads, SEO, and store data into a prioritized daily action list.

Most founders waste time checking multiple dashboards and still miss revenue leaks. DailyHelm reviews your business overnight and tells you what needs attention today, ranked by revenue impact.

How it Works

Step 1: Tell us about your business - A short setup covering what you sell, who buys it, and what success looks like. This anchors every recommendation. [...] Step 2: Connect your platforms - Link GA4, Google Ads, Search Console, Shopify, GitHub, GCP billing, and your site; DailyHelm opens the approval page for you to confirm each connection with one click.  
  
Step 3: Get a daily AI business review - Wake up to a prioritized punch list every morning, and chat with agent Aria anytime to dig deeper.  
  
Why It’s Different

It’s not just another analytics dashboard. Every finding includes evidence, confidence, a recommended fix, and an impact score... like broken GA4 tracking, wasted ad spend, SEO regressions, or failed-payment spikes.
